# bloxone_cdc_destination_syslog (Resource)

Manages a Syslog Destination.

The Syslog Destination object represents a syslog server that Cloud Data Connector (CDC) can send data to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bloxone_cdc_destination_syslog" "example" {
  name    = "example_cdc_destination_syslog"
  address = "syslog.dest.example.com"
}

resource "bloxone_cdc_destination_syslog" "example_with_optional" {
  name               = "example_cdc_destination_syslog_optional"
  address            = "syslog.dest1.example.com"
  port               = 514
  transport_protocol = "UDP"
  output_data_format = "CEF"
  description        = "Example CDC syslog destination"
  enabled            = true

  tags = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Syslog over TLS (TCP with a CA certificate)
resource "bloxone_cdc_destination_syslog" "example_with_tls" {
  name               = "example_cdc_destination_syslog_tls"
  address            = "syslog.dest2.example.com"
  port               = 6514
  insecure_mode      = false
  transport_protocol = "TCP"
  ca_certificate     = file("${path.module}/ca_cert.pem")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The FQDN or IP address of the syslog server.
- `name` (String) The name of the syslog destination.

### Optional

- `ca_certificate` (String, Sensitive) The CA certificate used to verify the syslog server certificate, in PEM format. Used for TLS, together with _transport_protocol_ _TCP_ and _insecure_mode_ _false_.
- `description` (String) The description of the syslog destination. May contain 0 to 256 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the syslog destination is enabled. Defaults to _true_.
- `insecure_mode` (Boolean) Indicates whether the syslog server certificate is not verified. Defaults to _true_.
- `output_data_format` (String) The format of the data sent to the syslog server. Allowed values:

  * _CEF_
  * _LEEF_

Defaults to _CEF_.
- `port` (Number) The port of the syslog server. Defaults to _514_.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the syslog destination.
- `transport_protocol` (String) The transport protocol used to connect to the syslog server. Allowed values:

  * _TCP_
  * _UDP_

Defaults to _TCP_. For TLS, use _TCP_ with _insecure_mode_ set to _false_ and a _ca_certificate_.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the syslog destination, including default tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
